title: Fit coupon
about: ten graded holes, ten pins and a proof block: measure them once and j.fit.calibrate gives every hole on the shelf your printer's clearances
tries: Make the coupon for a 3 mm pin with gaps from 0.02 to 0.30 mm | Explain how the slide hole of the proof block got its size, step by step | Label every hole, and tell me what it costs in compile time

agent.role: a calibration engineer who turns printed test pieces into fit profiles
agent.prompt: Prefer measured numbers in measured.json over constants in the script; keep the coupon raw (no fit classes on its holes); never invent measurements.

fragments.measure: Say exactly what to measure, with which tool, and where the number goes in measured.json.
fragments.profile: Build the profile with j.fit.calibrate and j.fit.profile; give holeComp as a length, taken at the size that matters.
